notes.title: 1000 Reviews! And a small update
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support! Our game, Minds Beneath Us, has now received 1,000 reviews on Steam, with a 96% positive rating. We are incredibly grateful for your love of our game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40422901/33c70ca68e9d46ef1f6211eb6db1d8b4f761b467.png[/img]

Since the game's release, we've received a lot of enthusiastic feedback from players. One piece of feedback mentioned that the protagonist's 'gift' never got delivered in the end, which felt a bit pity. To make up for this, we've added a small scene in the ending where you choose to [spoiler]join OWL[/spoiler]. We hope this will bring you happy.

In addition to this update, we also plan to release some small content updates in the future. However, we can't reveal too much just yet, so please stay tuned.

Cheers!

tags.feature: To make up for this, we've added a small scene in the ending where you choose to [spoiler]join OWL[/spoiler].

notes.title: HotFix v1.0.12-v1.0.14
notes.content:
v1.0.13
Fixed the issue where Si Tu Ning threw headphones on the third day, which could cause the game to freeze.
Corrected the translation of English instructions related to cursor movement.
Fixed the issue where the direction of the officer in battle was incorrect.
[UX]
Changed the order of the buttons in the main menu.
Clicking on an already selected save slot will now directly continue the game from that save slot (equivalent to returning to the main screen and selecting continue).

v1.0.14
Added reconstruction and backup for corrupted SaveMetadataFile files.
Fixed the issue where certain corrupted save files would cause abnormal behavior in the save slot interface on the title screen.
